instructions.heading: Steps to connecting your device
instructions.usb: Connect the board: plug it into your computer with a USB cable and open its serial console.
instructions.wifi: Put it on Wi‑Fi: type wifi, your network's name and its password, like wifi MyHome secret123.
instructions.pair: Ask for a pairing code: type pair. The board prints a code like 7K4M-Q9TX, valid for 15 minutes.
instructions.status: Note its MAC address: type status and copy the MAC line.
instructions.simulator: Using the simulator? Type <cmd>/enroll</cmd> and scan the QR code it shows.

code.heading: Scan the QR code
code.camera-needed: AirRemote needs the camera to scan the code.
code.camera-denied: Camera access is turned off. Turn it on in your settings, or enter the code manually.
code.invalid-scan: That QR code isn't an AirRemote pairing code.
code.manual-heading: Type the MAC address that <cmd>status</cmd> shows and the code that <cmd>pair</cmd> printed.
code.mac-address-invalid: Enter a MAC address like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

name.heading: Select a name for the new device
name.label: Device Name
name.invalid: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters.
